summary: Simplified the Reports filter and Overview surface without changing report calculations or backend data. The permission-scoped view selector now lives in the filter sheet; hidden presentation choices normalize to revenue/gross/no comparison; USD is the default and legacy or unknown stored currencies migrate to USD; the redundant Overview prose is removed; and Payment methods, Couriers, By reason, and Expenses by type render as contained horizontal buttons before the statement.
changes: frontend/src/components/sales/ReportsHub.tsx: moved the permission-filtered view picker into the single filter sheet, kept the filter trigger secondary/high contrast, counted and reset explicit style, made Show compact, and used USD directly as the report display default.
frontend/src/components/sales/reports/ReportOptionsFold.tsx: reduced the menu to View, supported query filters, Excel/Receipt style, and USD/KHR/Both currency.
frontend/src/components/sales/reports/reportModel.ts: normalized every effective basis/profit/comparison choice to revenue/gross/false and migrated retired or unknown currencies to USD.

frontend/src/components/sales/reports/OverviewReport.tsx: removed the duplicate prose summary and placed the four existing breakdown buttons before the canonical statement while preserving their Fold details.

frontend/src/components/sales/reports/reports-surface.css: added report-scoped compact filter styling, a contained horizontal breakdown row, a white high-contrast trigger, and a smaller Show button with a 44px target.
Updated five focused report tests to assert the canonical calculations, permission-scoped picker, reset behavior, summary removal, control order, and viewport containment.

evidence.claim: The report view remains permission scoped and is rendered once inside the filter sheet.
evidence.observed: visibleReportViews(perms) supplies AppSelect options, viewControl receives the single picker render, and unavailable stored views continue to fall back through resolveReportView.

evidence.claim: Removed controls cannot survive through stale local storage.
evidence.observed: collected/net/compare=true normalizes to revenue/gross/false; legacy setting and unknown EUR currency values normalize to USD; KHR and Both remain valid.

evidence.claim: Overview keeps one canonical financial statement and no duplicate summary prose.
evidence.source: actual React component browser harness and source tests
evidence.locator: OverviewReport rendered at browser-emulated widths 320, 375, 390, and 1280
evidence.observed: data-report-summary count was 0 at every width; the statement rendered Total Profit and Final Profit from buildIncomeStatement; the breakdown row preceded the statement frame.

evidence.claim: Narrow layouts remain contained while the four breakdown buttons stay readable.
evidence.observed: Document and hub scrollWidth equaled clientWidth at every width. The tab row used internal scrolling at 320/375/390 (scrollWidth 465; clientWidth 291/346/361) and did not widen the page. Filter sheet and grid stayed within each viewport.

evidence.claim: Compact actions and the collapsed layout do not leave a large empty area.
evidence.observed: Show measured 88x44, the filter trigger 44x44, the collapsed control occupied 66px including its padding and borders, and the next tab row began after the intended 8px layout gap.

evidence.claim: The moved view selector remains keyboard reachable and operable.
evidence.source: Playwright CLI against actual Fold, ReportOptionsFold, and AppSelect components
evidence.observed: Opening Filters focused Close; one Tab focused the View button; Enter opened its listbox; ArrowDown plus Enter selected Returns; reopening Filters showed Returns persisted.

report responsive source and CSS contracts

verification.observed: All four width records had document and hub clientWidth=scrollWidth; every Fold stayed within viewport; Basis/Profit/Compare/App setting were absent.

verification.scope: actual AppSelect keyboard access inside the mobile Fold

risks: Browser checks used Chromium viewport emulation with synthetic report data and actual report components; they are not tests on physical iOS hardware or an authenticated production session.

The report model retains compatibility fields for basis, profitMode, granularity, and compare because sibling calculation/export code still consumes the shared type; normalization now fixes their effective values.
not_done: No backend, migration, production data, deployment, shared/global style, language pack, or F65 code was changed.
No physical iOS device verification was claimed.
handoff: Cherry-pick the three listed commits in order. Re-run the five focused report tests after integration if adjacent report files changed. F65 Phase1 remains separate and untouched.
